posts.title: Fake loan app demands your secret number
posts.sms: Your quick loan of Sh50,000 is ready. Send Sh500 processing fee to pay now.
tips: Never send money to get a loan
No lender asks for your mobile money password
beats: Scammers use fake loan apps to steal your *money*.
They demand an advance fee before sending any cash.
Kenyans must never share their secret number with anyone.
Report fraudulent numbers to Safaricom on 333.
posts.message: Real lenders never ask for an advance fee or your secret number.
posts.action: Report scam numbers to Safaricom on 333.

scripts.radio:
Sasa, na karibu kwa Kenya on Record. Mimi ni host wako, na leo tunapitia habari na ukweli zilizotawala wiki hii. Twende moja kwa moja kwa yale yanayohusu maisha yetu ya kila siku.

Kwanza kabisa, wacha tuzungumzie mfuko wetu. Kule Nakuru, mambo si shwari baada ya bajeti ya kaunti kuzuiwa kufuatia maswali mazito kuhusu milioni ishirini na saba nukta tano za pesa za walemavu. Hii ni dharau kubwa, na viongozi lazima watoe majawabu. Hapa Nairobi, bei za vitu sokoni zinaendelea kutupa changamoto, na kupitia kipindi chetu cha Glasspoll, tunataka kujua kama unajua bei halisi za bidhaa za kila siku. Weka akili yako sawa.

Kwenye upande wa usalama wa dijiti, kuna uvumi unazagaa WhatsApp ati serikali inagawa laptop za bure kwa wanafunzi. Wakenya wenzangu, hizo ni porojo tupu, ni uongo mtupu! Na kuhusu ulaghai, kumbuka lile neno letu la wiki: Real lenders never ask for an advance fee or your M-Pesa PIN. Kama mtu anataka pesa ndogo ndogo ndipo akukopeshe, au anauliza PIN yako, huyo ni mwizi. Jitunze.

Mwisho, hebu tujivunie nchi yetu. Mlima Kenya, ule Mnara wa UNESCO wenye urefu wa mita elfu tano mia moja na tisini na tisa, uko pale kama fahari yetu. Na ukitaka kupita haraka, barabara ya Nairobi Expressway yenye kilomita ishirini na saba inakuunganisha kutoka Mlolongo hadi Westlands.

Asante kwa kusikiliza.

[Kiswahili Summary]
Wiki hii kwenye Kenya on Record: Bajeti ya Nakuru imezuiwa kwa sababu ya maswali ya pesa za walemavu, na Kitale kunahitajika uwajibikaji kufuatia migogoro ya kisiasa. Wakenya wameonywa dhidi ya ulaghai wa mikopo, uvumi wa laptop za serikali kwenye WhatsApp, huku tukikumbushwa kuhusu fahari yetu kama vile Mlima Kenya na Expressway.
scripts.voice_note: Sasa wangu. Sikia hapa, wiki hii kumechemka sana. Kwanza, ule uvumi wa WhatsApp ati serikali inagawa laptop za bure za wanafunzi ni uongo mtupu, wachana nao. Alafu, kule Nakuru, bajeti imezuiwa juu ya maswali ya milioni 27.5 za pesa za walemavu. Viongozi wanastahili kuwajibika. Kitale nako, migogoro ya kisiasa inahitaji polisi na viongozi wachukue hatua haraka. Na kwa wale wanatafuta mikopo, kumbuka: real lenders never ask for an advance fee or your M-Pesa PIN. Kuwa mwangalifu, usiibiwe!
scripts.sms: USIIBIWE: Real lenders never ask for an advance fee or your M-Pesa PIN. Keep your PIN secret and avoid mobile loan cons. Stay sharp with Kenya on Record.
scripts.reels:
[Visual: Bold text 'USIIBIWE' flashing on screen with an M-Pesa alert graphic]

Host Voice-Over (Confident, serious Kenyan English): 

"Listen up, Kenya! Real lenders never ask for an advance fee or your M-Pesa PIN. Period. If they want cash upfront or your secret numbers, that is a pure scam. Protect your hard-earned money. Stay sharp, stay informed with Kenya on Record!"
